what: SS&C Technologies provides software and outsourced operations to financial firms. It administers hedge funds and private equity funds, acts as transfer agent for mutual funds, and sells portfolio and accounting software.
customers: Hedge funds, private equity firms, mutual fund companies, insurers, banks and healthcare payers.
money: fund administration, transfer agency and outsourced operations
moat: Running the books and records of funds, where moving administrators means migrating years of positions and valuations under regulatory scrutiny.
risks: Debt of about $7.7 billion from a long series of acquisitions
Growth of about 7% is steady rather than fast
Integration of many acquisitions leaves significant goodwill
opportunities: Analysts see about 31% upside from current levels
Operating margin of 23% with revenue that renews at very high rates
Private markets growth increases demand for fund administration
watch: Organic revenue growth and the debt-to-EBITDA ratio.
